name: Spicy Rat
subtitle: Overcaffeinated • Volatile • Too Hot to Handle
description: Every adventurer starts with 'kill 5 rats', but this one isn't on the menu. The Spicy Rat is volatile, overcaffeinated chaos in fur form, and absolutely too hot to handle. Literally.

traits.name: Overheated Body.
traits.entries: A creature that touches the Spicy Rat or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.

traits.name: Volatile Squeak.
traits.entries: As a bonus action, the Spicy Rat emits a sharp, fiery squeak. Each creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or take 3 (1d6) fire damage.

traits.name: Too Hot to Handle.
traits.entries: The Spicy Rat has advantage on checks and saving throws to escape grapples or restraints.

traits.name: Explosive Death.
traits.entries: When the Spicy Rat dies, it explodes. Each creature within 10 feet must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

actions.name: Fiery Bite
actions.entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Spice Burst (Recharge 5-6)
actions.entries: The Spicy Rat releases a burst of burning spice in a 10-foot radius. Each creature in the area must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.
